Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Coverage by Andy Humm of the AIDS crisis demonstration at Trinity Church on March 24, 1987, interview with Larry Kramer 2. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 3. Short news stories, appeal for donations 3. Discussion of the New York Times coverage of AIDS issue, quality of series and whether it was timely or too-little-too-late COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 4. Continued discussion of New York Times AIDS coverage COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 5. Andy Humm on New York City's AIDS education 6. News Watch, Senator Pete Wilson introduces a bill to create a Congressional Advisory Panel on AIDS, headed by the National Academy of Sciences 7. Senator Dan Burton of Indiana proposes a bill for mandatory annual HIV testing for all US residents 8. New York, Queens co-op agrees to let a gay couple purchase an apartment after the couple went to the city's Commission on Human Rights 9. Congressional Hearing on AIDS Education finds that Federal response to AIDS epidemic is "slow, limited, and ultimately impotent" 10. Sports Report 11. Lavender Health, interview with Dava Weinstein, social worker, and co-chair of "10% of Those We Serve" chemical dependency conference 12. George Trahanis announces GCN's 5th anniversary, and a new pledge drive 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Episode of GCN's soap opera, "Suds": "A Farewell to Tom" 2. Closing credits
